results.summary_before: This design implements a simple VGA pong-style game with paddles controlled by four input pins. It outputs VGA signals on the bidirectional and output pins and supports two different VGA PMOD pinouts selected by an input, with the recommended Tiny VGA pinout. The game has no scoring and the ball only moves horizontally, so it is a minimal demonstration rather than a complete game. Silicon tests report that pong works, though one tester had to adjust monitor centering and another could not get a proper display on a CRT.
